messages:
sarah (sec-eng): Heads up — we have an external assessment kickoff next Tue. Assessor asked for RBAC snapshot, KMS key usage logs, and a 7-day sample of audit logs by EOD Mon. Who can own assembling evidence?
kevin (platform): I can grab RBAC exports and the IAM mappings. Will need a list of scopes they want.
jordan (infra): I can do KMS usage and CloudTrail exports, but need to confirm the KMS key alias to query and whether rotated keys should be included.
alice (compliance): Assessor wants key usage for both production and staging; they specifically asked for key aliases: redwood-prod-enc, redwood-staging-enc. Also want proof of key policy and rotation cadence.
sarah (sec-eng): Thanks. Jordan — please include a short README explaining search criteria and date windows. Also redact any user PII before handing off.
jordan (infra): Will do. Quick Q: for the CloudTrail export, should I include management events only or data events too?
alice (compliance): Include both but filter out S3 object-level content. We need evidence of API calls and KMS Decrypt/Encrypt events.
kevin (platform): For RBAC snapshot: I'll produce a CSV with: principal, role, resource regex, granted_at, source (scim vs manual). Any other columns?
sarah (sec-eng): Add "justification" if available and a link to the ticket where the role was approved.
secbot: Deployment 2024-11-13T04:22:11Z: infra/kms rotated key redwood-staging-enc (rotation-id: r-83a2).
jordan (infra): I saw the secbot rotation log. Should we include the rotation artifact?
alice (compliance): Yes — include rotation metadata, ARN, and the rotation schedule doc link.
external-assessor: Quick note from our side: please provide logs as gzipped JSONL, include mapping to timezone (UTC preferred), and a short index file describing each file.
sarah (sec-eng): Good call. We'll produce a zip: evidence_index.md + rbacs.csv + kms_usage.jsonl.gz + cloudtrail_sample.jsonl.gz + key_policy.pdf.
kevin (platform): Estimating ~2 hours to compile RBAC/CSP exports once I get the scope. Will post a presigned S3 link to the bucket redwood-assessments/incoming/1971122334.
jordan (infra): I can export KMS and CT samples by 17:00 PST today. Will sanitize and run a quick grep for obvious PII.
alice (compliance): I'll review before handoff and sign off on redaction. If all good, we can schedule retest window — assessor suggests 2 business days after remediation patch.
sarah (sec-eng): Let's plan a checkpoint sync tomorrow 10am PT to review artifacts. After that, ticketing: create a remediation epic and tag with #assess-1971. Can someone create the epic?
evelyn (project-bot): New ticket created: ENGSEC-1971 "Assessment intake & remediation epic" by sarah.
sarah (sec-eng): Thanks. Jordan/kevin/alice — please update ENGSEC-1971 with links to the presigned S3 objects.
kevin (platform): Roger. Will post links once upload completes.
jordan (infra): Upload in progress, ETA 16:48 PST.
alice (compliance): One last ask: for the retest, we need ephemeral assessor credentials. Engineering to request temporary AWS role via STS with expiration <= 24h.
sarah (sec-eng): Agreed. Kevin, can you prepare an IAM role (assessor/read-only) with session duration 12h and a trust policy for the assessor principal?
kevin (platform): I'll set it up and share the ARNs. Will also document the exact permissions.
sarah (sec-eng): Great — if anything blocks the evidence handoff, ping me directly. Otherwise see you at 10am PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
